direction.camera: Guide attention with pearl white; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: soft layered planes cradle a restrained product close-up; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with satin fold; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with delicate serif.
direction.lighting: wraparound pearl glow; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: mother-of-pearl and satin; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around graceful drift; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use pearl white,satin fold,soft specular,intimate macro,graceful drift,delicate serif as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
